title: qnsc-service values
description: The contract between gitops and the chart. `additionalProperties: false` is the point of this file: a values file with `singelton: true` should be REJECTED, not silently ignored. See kubernetes-platform-design.md §4b.

product.description: Short slug: rova · opshub · kb · lms · solodesk · ai-dev-kit. NOT qnsc-kb (§7c).

size.description: A CRITICALITY tier, not a resource size. rova is L and the smallest workload in the estate (§5).

auth.description: Credential mechanism. `password`: the credential is a CNPG managed-role password synced from Key Vault (secrets.db / dbWorker / dbMigrator). Token-per-connection (`iam`) was removed with the AWS estate.

host.description: Database host. NOT a secret — an endpoint is not a credential.

user.description: Postgres role the application connects as.

workerUser.description: Postgres role the worker connects as, when the product has a separate worker role (rova: <product>_worker). Defaults to `user`. Pair it with secrets.dbWorker.

migratorUser.description: Postgres role the migrator Job connects as. ONPREM-PLAN §6.3 names the managed roles <product>_app and <product>_migrator, so when `user` is <product>_app this must be set — the default (<user>_migrator) would derive <product>_app_migrator, a role nobody created.

cluster.description: CNPG cluster name; the app connects to <cluster>-rw.<namespace>.svc. Required when mode is cnpg.

namespace.description: Namespace holding the CNPG cluster (data-prod | data-dev).

caFile.description: Container path to mount the CNPG server CA (from the <product>-db-ca Secret, key ca.crt) and export as DATABASE_SSL_CA for TLS verify-full (ONPREM-PLAN §6.3).

kind.description: Capabilities live in templates/_kinds.tpl, not in template conditionals.

expose.description: `protected` is the state most of this estate needs and the one most easily got wrong (§4b).

arch.description: Defaults to amd64 (the on-prem host). Set only to override per service; arm64 images are still built while ECS runs on Graviton, but nothing on-prem schedules them.

singleton.description: Never two replicas, INCLUDING during a RollingUpdate. For a scheduler that holds no lock and cannot take one — Celery beat. NOT for workers that run scheduled work safely via SKIP LOCKED or a cross-pod lock (§4b Axis 7).

startupPath.description: Set for slow boots. qnsc-kb loads a ~1.5 GB ONNX session; without this the liveness probe kills the pod mid-load, forever (§9j).

tag.description: sha-<commit> in dev, v<version> in prod. NEVER latest — that is how a develop build reached a production task definition (§11). Ignored when digest is set.

digest.description: Pinned by digest (what k8s-deploy writes going forward). Wins over tag.

resources.description: Requests. The chart renders NO cpu limit and sets memory limit == request (§15d).

slo.description: Renders recording rules and burn-rate alerts. An SLO nobody will get out of bed for is not an SLO (§17).

drain.description: §4e — a realtime pod must stop accepting, send close frames, then exit.

sidecars.description: A sidecar works on Kubernetes exactly as it did on ECS, so a migration can be like-for-like. §4c argues a large read-only artefact belongs behind a Service instead — that is an optimisation, taken after the move, not during it.

host.description: Override the derived public hostname. The default is <product>-<service>[-dev].qnsc.vn. Used during the migration so the new estate can be proven on its own name while the canonical one still serves ECS.

web.description: Optional SPA served from the cluster (DELIVERY-DESIGN §3.1). Not a service: static files, /healthz probes, runtime config from web.config. The image repo lives in base/dev values and the generated tag/digest in tags.<env>.yaml (`web:`).

enabled.description: Off by default. Enabling it requires an image and renders Deployment + Service + ConfigMap (and a PDB when web.pdb is true).

port.description: Port the static server listens on (default 8080) and the Service exposes.

pdb.description: OFF by default: minAvailable 1 on a single replica blocks every node drain. Set true only with two or more replicas.

resources.description: Requests. No CPU limit and memory limit == request, like every service (sizes small by design).

config.description: Runtime SPA config, rendered verbatim as JSON to <product>-web-config/config.json and mounted at /srv/config.json. Never put a secret here: every browser can fetch it.

enabled.description: Render the namespace-wide default-deny set. On-prem sets false: the one data-prod NetworkPolicy lives in gitops/platform (ONPREM-PLAN §5.6/§6.2).

clusterCidrs.description: Pod and Service CIDRs excluded from the allow-egress-external rule, so default-deny egress also stops a product reaching other namespaces by IP. Defaults are k3s's.

egressNamespaces.description: Other namespaces this product may call, by namespace and TCP port (kb -> tei-e5 in `ai`). The destination must also admit this namespace in its own ingress policy.

secrets.description: workerOnly: Graph cert mount. clusterSecretStore/bundle/db/dbWorker/dbMigrator: the ExternalSecret source (ONPREM-PLAN §5.6).

clusterSecretStore.description: The platform ClusterSecretStore (kv-qnsc-<env>) every ExternalSecret reads. Required: the chart renders no SecretStore of its own.

bundle.description: DEPRECATED (use env). Key Vault secret (JSON object) behind <product>-app. Default <product>-<env>-app. Cannot be combined with env / envApiOnly.

env.description: ON-PREM: one Key Vault secret per value. Map of ENV_VAR_NAME -> Key Vault secret name (a plain string). Rendered as ExternalSecret <product>-env (one data entry per variable) and attached by envFrom to every service and cronjob, not the migrator Job. Replaces secrets.bundle.

envApiOnly.description: Same as env, rendered as <product>-env-api and attached to http services only (a secret a worker must not hold). A variable cannot be in both maps.

db.description: Key Vault secret (plain-string password) of the runtime DB role, rendered as <product>-db-app and attached by envFrom to the api (and the worker unless dbWorker is set). Default <product>-<env>-db-app.

dbWorker.description: Key Vault secret (plain-string password) of a separate worker DB role, rendered as <product>-db-worker and attached to worker services only. Unset = the worker uses `db`. Pair it with data.postgres.workerUser.

dbMigrator.description: Key Vault secret (plain-string password) of the migrator DB role, rendered as <product>-migrator (PreSync hook) for the migrator Job only. Default <product>-<env>-db-migrator.

api.description: Key Vault secret (JSON) rendered as <product>-api-bundle and attached by envFrom to the api ONLY, after the shared bundle (later wins). For products whose worker env schema refuses api-only secrets (opshub: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, ENTRA_CLIENT_SECRET, EDGE_CLIENT_IP_SECRET) and vice versa (GRAPH_*).

serviceBundles.description: One extra ExternalSecret per named service. The shared `bundle` keeps what both services genuinely share.

graphCert.description: Name of the Secret holding the Microsoft Graph certificate credential (one combined PEM). Mounted as a file into worker services only, never an env var (ONPREM-PLAN §7.1).

path.description: Container path to mount the combined PEM at; the worker reads AZURE_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PATH (ONPREM-PLAN §7.3).
